test_target.origin: Minimal UE4.27 C++ project written from scratch this session: uproject, game and editor Target.cs, one runtime module. Never had Python, EditorScriptingUtilities, or any bridge component before this run.

steps_proven: Scripts/install-mcp-bridge.ps1 copied MCPBridge and the pinned Puerts bundle, wrote the [MCPPuerTSBridge] pipe config, ran npm build (including the puerts JS staging step), and finished with the pin check green
UnrealBuildTool compiled BridgeInstallTestEditor Win64 Development: 78 actions, 137 seconds, zero errors, all five MCPBridge modules plus PuertsEditor and JsEnv
Editor started via Scripts/start-ue4-project.ps1; project-hashed pipe UE427PuerTSMCP_BridgeInstallTest_eb10ef4f appeared with no manual suffix

npm run smoke:puerts against the new project passed the consolidated milestone: find_actors, read_property, set_property, save, undo, read-back, save

defect_found_and_fixed.symptom: Installer crashed with 'property Count cannot be found' on the clean project
defect_found_and_fixed.cause: PowerShell 5.1 binds an empty array argument to a [string[]] parameter as null; strict mode rejects null.Count. Triggered only when the target has no DefaultEngine.ini, which every truly clean project lacks.

python_finding: PythonScriptPlugin mounts even in this blank project because stock Niagara mounts and force-enables it. Confirms the Python presence is engine-default behavior on this build and not caused by the bridge. The bridge descriptor is Python-free and the milestone ran with no Python involvement.
